summary: Plan, monitor and report donor-funded NGO projects using PRINCE2 controls. Explore the five-day foundation course and outline.
lede: NGO project management training helps project staff turn approved proposals and results frameworks into controlled delivery. For coordinators, officers and managers working on donor-funded projects, it covers stage planning, budget tracking, risk and issue registers, and quality and results records. Participants practise reconciling progress with expenditure and preparing concise internal and donor reports.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits NGO and development-sector staff who coordinate project delivery, partner inputs, expenditure tracking or results evidence and need to apply PRINCE2 controls in daily work.
modules: PRINCE2 Risk, Issue and Change Control
prerequisites: Foundation-level project staff who coordinate or support donor-funded project delivery. No coding or programming is required; routine spreadsheet and document-editor use will support the practical exercises.
